sentences.text: Two forms of neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis, a Kufs type and a late infantile form, are both linked to the gene CLN6 in curated databases [e_6dc087c1d0a1] [e_b4ef339e4b8d].
Constellate computed that they share this causal gene, with confidence 0.95, the lowest of the two gene links [e_4f98f11b139c].
For the late infantile form, one gene therapy trial is listed as completed [e_764bcd9e9447].
That record shows the study ended and does not show whether it helped [e_764bcd9e9447].
For the Kufs type, two features are listed, a build-up of fluorescent storage material in cells and deposits of a storage material in blood vessels [e_b95c825cc787] [e_108d9c44a76e].
Both are curated from OMIM with a low confidence of 0.5 [e_b95c825cc787] [e_108d9c44a76e].
These edges do not show symptoms of the late infantile form or any trial for the Kufs type [e_764bcd9e9447].
